q: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
opts: She will to call you tomorrow.
explain: Setelah "will", kata kerja selalu bentuk dasar (V1) — nggak boleh ditambah -s, nggak boleh pakai "to", dan "will" sendiri nggak berubah bentuk apapun subjeknya.

q: Choose the correct negative sentence using "will".
opts: He will not comes to the party.
He not will come to the party.
He won't to come to the party.
He won't come to the party.
explain: Won't (= will not) langsung diikuti V1 tanpa "to" dan tanpa perubahan bentuk kata kerja.

q: Choose the correct question form.
explain: Bentuk tanya simple future: Will + S + V1 — "will" dipindah ke depan subjek, kata kerja tetap V1.

q: Complete: "I ___ visit my grandmother next week."
explain: Subjek "I" selalu berpasangan dengan "am", bukan is/are.

q: Complete: "They ___ travel to Bandung this weekend."
explain: Subjek jamak "they" berpasangan dengan "are".

q: Complete: "He ___ attend the seminar tomorrow."
explain: Subjek tunggal orang ketiga "he" berpasangan dengan "is".

q: Complete: "We ___ join the trip because of the rain." (negative)
explain: Subjek "we" pakai "are", jadi bentuk negatifnya "aren't going to".

q: Complete the question: "___ she going to cook dinner tonight?"
explain: Subjek "she" berpasangan dengan "is" — be dipindah ke depan subjek untuk bentuk tanya.

q: Complete: "By 8 PM tomorrow, I ___ for the test." (study)
explain: Menekankan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di satu titik waktu tertentu (jam 8 malam besok) = future continuous: will + be + V-ing.

q: Complete: "She ___ at midnight — she has a night shift." (not/sleep)
explain: Future continuous negatif: S + won't + be + V-ing. "Be" wajib ada sebelum V-ing.

q: Complete the future continuous question: "___ you be doing this time next week?"
explain: Kata tanya (what) selalu di paling depan kalimat, baru diikuti will + subjek + be + V-ing.

q: "Look at those clouds! It ___ soon." (rain)
explain: Ada bukti konkret di depan mata (awan gelap) yang mendukung prediksi ini — pakai going to, bukan will.

q: "I've already booked the flight tickets. We ___ to Bali next month." (go)
explain: Tiket sudah dipesan sebelum kalimat ini diucapkan — ini rencana yang sudah diatur, bukan keputusan dadakan, jadi pakai going to.

q: "I don't know what to have for lunch. I think I ___ pizza." (order)
explain: Keputusan baru dibuat saat itu juga (spontan), belum direncanakan sebelumnya — pakai will.

q: "A: 'The doorbell is ringing.' B: 'I ___ it.'" (get)
explain: Keputusan spontan yang muncul saat itu juga karena bel berbunyi — pakai will.

q: "Based on the current economic data, experts believe the company ___ financial trouble next year." (face)
explain: Prediksi ini didasarkan pada bukti konkret (data ekonomi), bukan sekadar opini — pakai going to.

q: "I promise I ___ anyone your secret." (never/tell)
explain: Ini janji (promise) — fungsi utama "will". "Won't never" salah karena double negative, dan "never will telling" salah bentuk (harus V1, bukan V-ing).

q: "She has just failed her driving test three times. She ___ on getting her license." (give up)
explain: Kegagalan berulang jadi bukti nyata yang mendukung prediksi ini — pakai going to.

q: "A: 'Why are you carrying that suitcase?' B: 'I ___ my cousin in Surabaya — I've had this planned for weeks.'" (visit)
explain: "Planned for weeks" secara eksplisit menunjukkan ini rencana yang sudah dipikirkan sebelumnya — pakai going to.

q: "I can't decide what to wear. Okay, I ___ the blue dress." (wear)
explain: Keputusan baru diambil saat itu juga setelah bimbang — pakai will.

q: "According to the official weather forecast, it ___ sunny this weekend." (be)
explain: Forecast resmi = bukti/data konkret yang mendukung prediksi — pakai going to.

q: "I have a feeling that team ___ the championship this year." (win)
explain: "I have a feeling" menandakan ini opini/perkiraan pribadi, bukan bukti konkret — pakai will.

q: "We've hired a wedding planner and booked the venue. We ___ in December." (get married)
explain: Sudah menyewa wedding planner dan memesan venue — rencana sudah diatur sebelumnya, pakai going to.

q: Which sentence correctly uses future continuous to describe an action in progress at a specific future time?
opts: I will call you at 7 PM.
At 7 PM, I will be having dinner with my parents.
I am going to call you at 7 PM.
explain: Future continuous (will be + V-ing) menekankan aksi yang sedang berlangsung tepat pada titik waktu tertentu di masa depan, bukan sekadar aksi yang akan terjadi.

q: Which signal word most strongly signals future continuous rather than simple future?
explain: "At this time tomorrow" menunjuk ke satu titik waktu spesifik di masa depan — ciri khas future continuous, bukan cuma "besok" secara umum.

q: "Will you be using the printer soon?" is an example of future continuous used for...
explain: Future continuous sering dipakai untuk menanyakan rencana orang lain dengan nada lebih sopan/netral, nggak terkesan mengatur-ngatur.

q: Complete: "While you ___ tonight, I ___ dinner." (study / cook)
explain: Klausa "while" memakai present tense, dan klausa utamanya memakai future continuous untuk aksi yang akan sedang berlangsung bersamaan.

q: Complete: "This time next month, they ___ around Europe." (travel)
explain: Future continuous: S + will + be + V-ing, berlaku sama untuk semua subjek termasuk "they".

q: "What will you be doing at 10 AM tomorrow?" is most likely asking about...
opts: an action in progress at a specific future time
explain: Pertanyaan ini menanyakan aksi apa yang akan sedang berlangsung tepat jam 10 pagi besok — fungsi utama future continuous.

q: Choose the correctly ordered future continuous question.
opts: You will be doing what tomorrow?
What you will be doing tomorrow?
What will you be doing tomorrow?
Will what you be doing tomorrow?
explain: Urutan yang benar: kata tanya + will + subjek + be + V-ing.

q: Which sentence is an example of future continuous, NOT simple future?
opts: I will finish my homework tonight.
I will be finishing my homework at 9 PM tonight.
I am going to finish my homework tonight.
explain: Hanya opsi B yang memakai will + be + V-ing dan menekankan aksi yang sedang berlangsung pada titik waktu tertentu (jam 9 malam).

q: Find the error: "She going to travel to Japan next year."
explain: Going to selalu butuh be (am/is/are) sesuai subjeknya. Subjek "she" butuh "is" sebelum "going to".

q: Find the error: "At this time tomorrow, I will studying for my exam."
explain: Future continuous wajib pakai will + be + V-ing. Kata "be"-nya hilang di kalimat ini.

q: Find the error: "You will be doing what at this time tomorrow?"
explain: Kata tanya "what" harus di paling depan kalimat: "What will you be doing at this time tomorrow?"

q: Find the error: "I think it going to rain later."
explain: Subjek "it" butuh "is" sebelum "going to" — bentuk going to selalu butuh be.

q: Find the error: "We will be arrive at the station at 6 PM."
explain: Setelah will + be, kata kerja harus V-ing, bukan V1. Seharusnya "will be arriving".

q: Find the error: "A: 'Why do you have a suitcase?' B: 'I go to visit my aunt this weekend.'"
explain: Konteks menunjukkan rencana yang sudah diatur (membawa koper), jadi seharusnya bentuk going to lengkap: "I'm going to visit".

q: Find the error: "He won't to come to the meeting tomorrow."
explain: Setelah won't (will not), kata kerja langsung V1 tanpa "to".

q: Find the error: "They isn't going to attend the party."
explain: Subjek jamak "they" harus pakai "aren't", bukan "isn't".

q: "A: 'The printer is out of paper.' B: 'Oh, I ___ some from the storage room.'" (get)
explain: Keputusan spontan yang baru muncul saat mendengar masalah itu — pakai will.

q: "A: 'What are your plans after graduation?' B: 'I ___ abroad — I've already applied to three universities.'" (study)
explain: Sudah mendaftar ke tiga universitas = rencana yang sudah dipikirkan sebelumnya — pakai going to.

q: "Budi has saved money for two years and already picked a car model. Next month, he ___ his first car." (buy)
explain: Menabung dua tahun dan sudah memilih model mobil = bukti kuat rencana yang sudah matang — pakai going to.

q: "Rina hears her phone buzzing but has no idea who it is. 'I wonder who that is. I ___ it.'" (check)
explain: Keputusan dibuat saat itu juga, tanpa rencana sebelumnya — pakai will.

q: Choose the sentence that best expresses a promise.
opts: I am going to help you with your homework.
I promise I will always be there for you.
I help you with your homework.
I am helping you with your homework.
explain: Janji (promise) adalah salah satu fungsi utama "will", bukan going to.

q: Which sentence best shows an action in progress at a specific point in the future?
opts: I will visit my grandparents next week.
This time next week, I will be visiting my grandparents.
I am going to visit my grandparents next week.
I visited my grandparents last week.
explain: Hanya opsi B (future continuous) yang menekankan aksi sedang berlangsung pada titik waktu spesifik di masa depan.

q: "Meteorologists say that based on satellite data, a storm ___ the coast tomorrow morning." (hit)
explain: Prediksi ini berdasarkan data satelit (bukti konkret) — pakai going to.

q: "A: 'Why is your bag so heavy?' B: 'I've packed all my camping gear — we ___ hiking this weekend.'" (go)
explain: Sudah mengemas semua peralatan camping = rencana yang sudah disiapkan sebelumnya — pakai going to.

q: Choose the best response to: "Can you help me carry these boxes?"
opts: Sure, I'm going to help you.
explain: Ini tawaran menolong yang diputuskan saat itu juga (spontan) — fungsi will, bukan going to.
